info.name: 18 - Workout Plans
info.description: Endpoints to manage workout plans (templates with sessions and exercises, pending platform approval).

request.description:
### Endpoint Overview

Fetches a paginated list of workout plans for the current gym with dynamic sorting and filtering.

---

### Available Domain Attributes & Filter Reference

| Attribute Name | Data Type | Filter Support | Description / Allowed Values |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Id` | `int` | Exact | Unique Identifier |
| `GymId` | `int` | Exact | Associated Gym ID |
| `PlanName` | `string` | Searchable | Plan name (max 200 chars) |
| `Description` | `string` | Searchable | Plan description (max 500 chars) |
| `IsApproved` | `bool` | - | Platform approval status |
| `CreatedOn` | `DateTime` | Between | ISO creation date |

---

### Filter Usage Guide (For Request Body)

- **Exact Filters (`exactFilters`):** Pass attribute name with array of string/enum values. Example: `"exactFilters": { "IsApproved": ["true"] }`
- **Between Filters (`betweenFilters`):** Pass attribute name with `min` and `max`. Example: `"betweenFilters": { "CreatedOn": { "min": "2026-01-01", "max": "2026-12-31" } }`

---

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Coach`, or `Member`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Fetches a single workout plan by ID, including its sessions and exercises.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Coach`, or `Member`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Creates a new workout plan with nested sessions.

### Request Fields (`WorkoutPlanCDTO`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `planName` | `string` | Yes | Max 200 characters |
| `description` | `string?` | No | Max 500 characters |
| `sessions` | `SessionCDTO[]` | Yes | At least one session required |

### Session Fields (`SessionCDTO`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `dayNumber` | `int` | Yes | 1–365 |
| `sessionName` | `string` | Yes | Max 100 characters |
| `exercises` | `SessionExerciseCDTO[]` | No | Exercises in this session |

Returns `201 Created` with `Result<WorkoutPlanRDTO>`.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Updates an existing workout plan by ID. Only SuperAdmin can update.

### Request Fields (`WorkoutPlanUDTO`)

| `planName` | `string` | Yes | Max 200 characters |
| `description` | `string?` | No | Max 500 characters |

### Authorization

Requires `SuperAdmin` role.
